method: True nightly cost is computed only when a date-specific room rate, the mandatory resort fee, and the property-specific room tax are all verified. The Clark County room tax of 13.38% is confirmed from the official Clark County transient lodging licence list for every property below, and the resort fee is confirmed from each property's own official terms except Caesars Palace. No date-specific room rate was confirmable from an official source, so every true nightly total is blank and flagged in data/hotel_rates.json rather than estimated.
